descFull: 透過 MCP（Model Context Protocol），使 AI 工具能夠與 LINE Desktop 整合，並執行訊息的讀取與發送操作。Through the MCP (Model Context Protocol), AI tools can be integrated with LINE Desktop to perform message reading and sending operations.
